Name: Survival Needs
Author: XSWHQY
Description:
[b]INTRODUCTION[/b]

Survival Needs adds a survival system to 《Stardew Valley》providing players with a more realistic survival challenge beyond farm management.
This mod introduces a hunger system, requiring players to consume various foods in the game to maintain their hunger level. Hunger gradually decreases over time. Neglecting food for an extended period will result in various negative consequences.

To enhance immersion, this mod displays a hunger UI in the upper left corner of the game interface. Hunger automatically changes, gradually decreasing from full to empty, allowing players to intuitively understand their survival status.
[line]

[b]Features[/b]
Hunger System
Adds a hunger value system (0%-100%)
Uses a HUD icon to display the current hunger status
Supports multiple hunger levels: Players can quickly determine their current hunger level through icon changes.
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/192479867-1788455796.png[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/192479867-1788455878.png[/img]
[b]Hunger Consumption[/b]
Hunger continuously decreases over time.

[i][b]Current Mechanism:[/b][/i]
[i]Satiety decreases by 3 points every 10 minutes.
You start each day with a base satiety level.
Satiety does not regenerate automatically; it must be replenished with food.[/i]
[i]Players need to plan their food reserves carefully to avoid starvation.[/i]

[b]Food Recovery System[/b]
Eating food in the game restores the corresponding amount of satiety.

[b]Hunger Penalty[/b]
When satiety decreases, players suffer negative effects.
[i]Current Effect:[/i]
[i]Low satiety reduces movement speed.
The lower the satiety, the more pronounced the movement speed penalty.[/i]
[i]Players cannot ignore hunger indefinitely and need to replenish food promptly.[/i]

[b]Hunger Status[/b]
When satiety drops to 0, the player enters a state of severe hunger.
[i]Effect:
Continuous loss of health after satiety is depleted.
Taking damage every 10 minutes.
Minimum remaining health is 1 point.[/i]
[i]Players will not die instantly from hunger, but will be in a very dangerous state.[/i]
[i][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/192479867-1788455935.png[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/192479867-1788456012.png[/img][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/192479867-1788456055.png[/img][/i]
[line]

[i]Installation Method
Install SMAPI
Download this mod
After extraction, place the SurvivalNeeds folder in:
Stardew Valley/Mods
Launch the game via SMAPI
Prerequisites
SMAPI
Supports: Stardew Valley 1.6+[/i]

[b][i][u]This mod modifies the player's survival mechanics and movement speed.[/u][/i][/b]
[u][i]Most gameplay mods are compatible.
If other mods also modify player movement speed, conflicts may occur.[/i][/u]

[line]

[b]Future Plans
[/b]Planned additions:
More detailed food stats
Hunger-related status effects
Fatigue system
More survival mechanics
